title: 好莱坞霸权非偶然：美国共识花了几十年，宝莱坞输在本土太大？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: It is interesting when you take a look at India, it has a long history of cinema, of technology like you mentioned, even spirituality.
segments.zh: 有趣的是，看看印度，它有着悠久的电影、科技甚至灵性历史。

segments.en: If you take a look at Bollywood for instance, why hasn't Bollywood gotten the traction the way Hollywood has, despite the long history, the investments in it?
segments.zh: 比如宝莱坞，为什么它没有像好莱坞那样获得关注，尽管历史悠久、投入巨大？

segments.en: It's a great question and I'm sure it's going to get me into trouble.
segments.zh: 这是个好问题，我肯定它会给我惹麻烦。

segments.en: Many reasons, you know, first and foremost, Hollywood was not created accidentally.
segments.zh: 原因很多，首先，好莱坞不是偶然创建的。

segments.en: There was a broader social, political, governmental consensus to create, to use the power of American
segments.zh: 当时有更广泛的社会、政治、政府共识来创建，利用美国

segments.en: content, American media to build a story globally and reinforce Brande U.S.
segments.zh: 内容、美国媒体在全球构建故事，强化美国品牌。

segments.en: And it's taken decades. It hasn't happened accidentally.
segments.zh: 这花了几十年，不是偶然发生的。

segments.en: First there was vision and then there was support from all stakeholders because they believed in the power of that.
segments.zh: 首先有愿景，然后所有利益相关者都支持，因为他们相信这种力量。

segments.en: But in India, two or three things have come in the way of that.
segments.zh: 但在印度，有两三件事阻碍了这一点。

segments.en: First of all, when you're a very big country like India, your domestic market itself can be big enough to satisfy your hunger.
segments.zh: 首先，当你是像印度这样的大国时，你的国内市场本身就足够大，可以满足你的需求。

segments.en: But the question is whether it's really enough. You talk about how Bollywood can break even and that's good enough for them.
segments.zh: 但问题在于这是否真的足够。你说宝莱坞能收支平衡，对他们来说就够了。

segments.en: When you take a look at the skill, the numbers, I mean, they look pretty good.
segments.zh: 当你看看技能和数字，我的意思是，它们看起来相当不错。

segments.en: When you take a look at the revenue, it isn't so great. In fact, you know, the revenue generated by Bollywood is just a fraction of Hollywood.
segments.zh: 当你看看收入，它并不那么出色。事实上，你知道，宝莱坞产生的收入只是好莱坞的一小部分。
